notes.title: Mouse support and new achievements!
notes.content:
This new patch brings a much-requested feature, mouse support! Players who had difficulty just playing on the keyboard or gamepad can now be relieved.


Mouse support implemented
Two new secret achievements
Voice logo intro

notes.title: Bug fixes and a key remapping system.
notes.content:
Fixed when you could enter the menu while an item was selected.
 Fixed when you could enter the menu while an item was selected to combine.
 A key remap system was added.
 Fixed issue with game crashing when changing resolution.
